headline.title: Synthesia’s AI training platform is moving beyond videos into live coaching
headline.summary: Synthesia has introduced AI Roleplay Sessions, an interactive training platform that allows employees to engage in workplace conversations with AI avatars. This new feature provides feedback, scoring, and analytics to help companies assess the effectiveness of their training programs.

articles.title: [Paper] Stringological sequence prediction II
articles.summary: The article presents a new algorithm for sequence prediction that focuses on right-to-left automaticity, a stringological measure distinct from the previously studied left-to-right automaticity. The authors demonstrate the algorithm's statistical and computational efficiency, contributing to the broader understanding of sequence prediction in stringology.

articles.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
articles.summary: New Gemini models have been launched, including Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber. These updates expand the Gemini lineup with enhanced features and capabilities.

articles.title: The Anthropic-Physical Intelligence rumor roiling AI Twitter
articles.summary: Rumors have emerged on AI Twitter regarding a potential acquisition involving Anthropic and OpenAI, fueled by their aggressive expansion plans for 2026. The speculation has sparked discussions within the AI community about the implications of such a move.

articles.title: S2T-RLHF: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Stable Preference-Based RLHF
articles.summary: The paper introduces S2T-RLHF, a method designed to improve the stability of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) by implementing hierarchical credit assignment. This approach addresses the ambiguity in credit assignment during training by refining rewards into denser token-level supervision, enhancing the effectiveness of preference-based reward models.

articles.title: The Economics of Autonomy: Real-Time Risk Indexing for Insurable AI-Driven 6G Systems
articles.summary: The article discusses the implications of sixth-generation (6G) networks on wireless infrastructure, highlighting the need for adaptive risk management frameworks due to the rapid orchestration capabilities of autonomous AI systems. It introduces the Governance-Indexing for Risk Assessment Framework (GIRAF) as a solution to address the challenges posed by the dynamic nature of AI-driven environments.

articles.title: Quantum Cryptanalysis on IBM Quantum Hardware: Extending Even--Mansour Period Recovery from $N=4$ to $N=10$
articles.summary: Researchers have successfully executed quantum cryptanalysis of the Even-Mansour cipher on IBM quantum hardware, extending the period recovery capability from a security parameter of N=4 to N=10. This achievement utilizes Simon's algorithm and marks a significant advancement in the practical application of quantum computing for cryptographic analysis.

articles.title: Structured Output Collapses Answer Diversity Across 44 Language Models
articles.summary: A study published on arXiv investigates how a format clause, specifically requesting responses in JSON, affects answer diversity among 44 language models across 31 prompts. The findings reveal that this structured output significantly reduces the variety of responses, leading to a notable convergence in the answers provided by the models.

articles.title: CoGoal3D: Collaborative 3D Object Detection with 3D-Aware Fusion and Refinement
articles.summary: The article presents CoGoal3D, a novel approach to collaborative 3D object detection that addresses the limitations of traditional single-vehicle systems by integrating environmental features from multiple agents. The method enhances detection accuracy by employing 3D-aware fusion and refinement techniques to mitigate spatial misalignment issues caused by variations in height and attitude among collaborators.

articles.title: SciCodePile: A 128GB Corpus and Executable Benchmark for Challenging Scientific Code Generation
articles.summary: SciCodePile is introduced as a 128GB corpus designed to benchmark scientific code generation, addressing the limitations of existing datasets in scale, domain coverage, and executable verification. This resource aims to better assess the capabilities of large language models in generating reliable scientific code.

articles.title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
articles.summary: The article presents Agentic Real2Sim, a novel approach to physics-based world modeling that enhances the real-to-sim conversion process for robotic interactions. By integrating vision-language agents, the method aims to automate the recovery of scene geometries, object states, and physical parameters, reducing the reliance on manual tuning and improving simulation efficiency.

articles.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
articles.summary: ABot-World-0 is a new action-conditioned video world model that enables real-time, long-horizon interactions on a single desktop GPU, leveraging a diverse data infrastructure from AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos. The model includes a WorldExplorer component for agent-driven data collection and a unified pipeline that implements multiple quality checks and assessments.
